method: Front-wall native luma is sampled at three upright columns about each volume sightline with a six-row sensor pitch. The pre-pour photographed contact seeds a continuous sequence of downward intensity transitions into uniformly dark liquid. The path scores all frames using their time spacing, direction-independent smoothness and local contrast. The post-pour photograph supplies only the separate endpoint error. Positions, including fractional estimates, are in native sensor pixels. Camera stamps determine the measured phase windows.
